name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Strawberry Lemonade
description: Strawberry Lemonade tastes like the lemonade stand discovered the candy aisle. Juicy strawberry brings a ripe, almost syrupy sweetness before a squeeze of bright lemon cuts in with just enough pucker. The whole thing gets wrapped in tiny, colorful crunchy candies, creating a crackly first bite before giving way to two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy underneath.
